title.narrative: EU for Climate Action in the ENI Southern Neighbourhood

description.narrative: The aim of this contract is to provide technical assistance to support the transition of Southern Neighbourhood countries towards sustainable, low-carbon and climate-resilient development. This will be achieved, amongst others, through the formulation and implementation of climate actions (mitigation and adaptation) and of sustainable energy policies (i.e. access to clean energy, energy efficiency and the use of renewable energy) both at national and local level.
